_comment: Canonical ComfyUI qualification fixtures — the repeatable render definitions used by explicit qualification runs (scripts/comfyui-workflow-check.js <id> --qualify-render). Source-controlled so qualification is reproducible: fixed prompt, fixed seed, pinned source-image hash, and the exact technical output contract the render must satisfy. Qualification proves technical validity only — never editorial quality.
